summaryZh: Joe Pogliano 实验室研究噬菌体的细胞生物学，包括噬菌体核、纺锤体及感染周期，也研究新抗生素的作用机制与耐药性。团队使用延时显微成像和细菌细胞学表型分析（BCP）筛选、研究抗菌化合物。
researchQuestions: 噬菌体核及相关结构如何组织感染周期？
新抗生素如何发挥作用，耐药性如何产生？
methods: 细菌细胞学表型分析 BCP

evidence.quote: Our lab has been working on the cell biology of Pseudomonas ΦKZ-like phage for more than a decade.
Time-lapse microscopy demonstrates that proteins destined for the nucleus are synthesized in the cytoplasm and then accumulate in the phage nucleus.
We investigate how resistance to these new antibiotics arises and how treatment can be modified to lead to a more successful clinical outcome
We have developed bacterial cytological profiling (BCP) in collaboration with Kit Pogliano, a new method for screening for novel antibiotics and determining their mechanisms of action
We are using this method to screen libraries of natural products for novel compounds active against multidrug resistant bacteria.
The phage nucleus assembles from protomers of a phage-encoded nuclear shell protein we termed “chimallin”
is positioned at midcell by the bipolar PhuZ spindle.
